name: Del cerezo
overview: The "Sakura no" series is a deeply philosophical visual novel saga created by the Japanese developer Makura. Centered around protagonist Naoya Kusanagi, it begins in Sakura no Uta following his father's death, exploring themes of art, aestheticism, and human connection as Naoya navigates his new school life alongside childhood friends. Its sequel, Sakura no Toki, continues this profound coming-of-age journey, exploring mimesis, genius, and how talented individuals leave their mark on the world even long after they are gone.
